name: Quilt
author: support@cinammon.net
description: The Quilt project is an open-source, community-driven modding toolchain designed primarily for Minecraft. By focusing on speed, ease of use and modularity, Quilt aims to provide a sleek and modern modding toolchain with an open ecosystem.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Quilt Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apk add --no-cache openjdk21-jre-headless curl

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

curl -sSL -o quilt.jar https://quiltmc.org/api/v1/download-latest-installer/java-universal
java -jar quilt.jar install server ${MC_VERSION} --download-server

if [ -d /mnt/server/server ]; then
    cd /mnt/server/server
    mv * /mnt/server/
    cd /mnt/server
    rmdir /mnt/server/server
fi

rm -f quilt.jar
if [ -f server.jar ] && [ -f quilt-server-launch.jar ]; then
    mv server.jar minecraft.jar
    mv quilt-server-launch.jar server.jar
    echo "serverJar=minecraft.jar" > quilt-server-launcher.properties
fi

echo "Server is Ready!"
